Uz.bar_b_note: The big-eared fox silhouette reads and stands above the ruler, but the busy blue printed pattern over orange fur reads as a textile print rather than Palworld-clean or owner-bar naturalistic markings, and the hit react is either a near-copy of the sit (A) or a hop off the floor (B).

Hf.bar_b_note: The standing ram is the owner-approved Stormcapra and holds up, but on A the hit react is a copy of the stand and both faint frames collapse into a twisted black-and-white blob, and even B's fleece-lump faint hides the face, so the set does not reach Palworld finish.

Xs.bar_b_note: The standing ram model is on the owner bar, but B's faint frames read as a twisted mottled shape and A's faint is a horned fleece lump with no visible face, so the pose read sinks it beside Palworld.

Iw.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing read as a built wall, but it stands alone in a flat-lit field beside an untextured pale grey boulder with no haze, shafts or time-of-day grade, so it is not Palworld-base or Valheim-light finish.

Ys.bar_b_note: A's black-and-gold serpent is muddy and low in value contrast with near-identical stand, hit and faint-mid poses, while B's bold yellow-banded cobra reads well standing but rises into the air in both faint frames with its shadow detached on the floor.

Nz.bar_b_note: A's matte slate-and-tan Galecrest matches the owner style bar, with a clear lean-back hit and a wings-spread carry, which is Palworld-level creature finish; B's over-bright white plastic sheen is what would sink it.

Ct.bar_b_note: The white-bearded elder reads clearly, with readable eyes, earthy green-and-brown village clothes and a Palworld-class stylised finish, though his softer, rounder face is a touch more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures and the dark stage gives no light or atmosphere evidence.

Qg.bar_b_note: This is the same fox as Uz: a clear big-eared silhouette that is grounded in the faint, sunk by the busy blue print pattern and by a hit react that is either a hop off the floor (A) or close to the standing sit (B).

top_changes.change: Ground and re-author the hurt/faint poses: snap the faint root to the stage so the body lies on its side facing camera (ram Hf A / Xs B twisted blob, serpent Ys B floating S-curve), and replace near-copy or airborne hit reacts with a grounded recoil (fox Uz/Qg, ram Hf A / Xs B, serpent Ys A)

Matte the creature materials and restore a value range: remove the over-bright white plastic sheen and hard rim on Nz B, lift the muddy black-gold serpent Ys A, and calm the fox's busy blue print into fur-following markings

Keep the capped, brace-framed, stone-footed homestead wall (Iw A) over the blank pale panel (Iw B), and replace the untextured pale grey boulder beside it with a textured rock that matches the Meadows
